 ---------
 th Order No. 06/Dated: 12 March, 2024  Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Dhanwar P.S. Case No. 94 of 2022 instituted under Sections 498A, 341, 342, 323, 325, 307, 379, 504, 506, 34 of the I.P.C. and Section 3 / 4 of the Prevention of Witch Practices Act, the petitioner has moved to this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.

As per the FIR, the allegation is that the marriage of the informant was solemnized with this petitioner on 25.04.2012 and after some days of marriage, the petitioner and in-laws of the informant started demanding Rs. 5,00,000/- as dowry and on non-fulfillment of the same, the accused persons assaulted the informant physically and mentally.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has further submitted that notice was sent to the opposite party no. 2, but inspite of valid service of notice, she has not appeared before this Court.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has further submitted that charge sheet has been submitted, as such, there is no requirement for the purpose of investigation.
There is allegation and counter allegation between the petitioner and opposite party no. 2 regarding their conjugal affairs.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has further submitted that a proceeding under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act was initiated by the present petitioner, which was dismissed.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has further submitted that the marriage of the petitioner and opposite party no. 2 was Pankaj Kumar Yadav vs The State Of Jharkhand & Another ..... ... on 12 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77228438/
1 solemnized in the year 2012 and out of the wedlock, three children were born and two of them are residing with their father (present petitioner).

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There is general and omnibus allegation about subjecting the opposite party no. 2 with cruelty and physical assault.
Hence, petitioner may be enlarged on anticipatory bail.

Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner and has submitted that there is directed allegation against the petitioner of assaulting opposite party no. 2 and charge sheet for the offences under Sections 498A, 341, 342, 323, 325, 504, 506 / 34 of the I.P.C. has been submitted against the petitioner.
Hence, petitioner does not deserve the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation against petitioner coupled with materials available on record, I am inclined to extend privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrendering, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned J.M., 1st Class, Giridih in connection with Dhanwar P.S. Case No. 94 of 2022 with the condition that he will furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Sunil/
